Head positioned in the upper half of the canvas with a little space above the head, broad powerful shoulders filling the canvas width. Light source from the upper left, plus warm forge glow from below on one side. Weathered, believable craftsman, hearty and friendly. Clothes are worn and practical: no shiny armour, no rust, nothing dark or corrupted.
DETAILS: Master Gorran the Blacksmith. Big bald man in his forties, hearty friendly smile, warm kind eyes looking directly into the camera / at the viewer, thick braided red-brown beard with a few singed hairs. Black soot smudges on his forehead and rugged cheeks, thick powerful neck. Heavy leather apron over a sleeveless sweat-darkened coarse grey shirt. His thick muscular, hairy, soot-stained arm and hand is raised to firmly grip and hold the heavy iron blacksmith tongs resting securely over his shoulder. Glow of the forge lighting him warm orange from below on one side. Welcoming master craftsman greeting the player warmly. Colours strictly: steel grey, leather brown, forge orange, natural ruddy skin tones. Bold inked outlines.
